page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5i-c16g1.8xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance within the ecs.gn5i family, running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated physical cores and 32 vCPUs, operating with 1.0 thread per core. The system is equipped with 128.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 4.0 GB per core.

This instance integrates dedicated hardware acceleration, featuring two NVIDIA P4 GPUs with a combined total of 16 GB of VRAM. It does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through external network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 6 Gbps.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the instance provides a balanced resource density of dedicated compute cores and entry-level enterprise GPUs, making it suitable for workloads that require parallel processing without the premium cost of high-end accelerators. Appropriate workloads include GPU-accelerated web serving, media transcoding, lightweight machine learning inference, and parallelized compute tasks that do not require high-speed local storage.
